# uptimekuma_notification_promosms (Resource)

PromoSMS notification resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uptimekuma_notification_promosms" "example" {
  name           = "PromoSMS Notification"
  is_active      = true
  login          = "your_promosms_login"
  password       = "your_promosms_password"
  phone_number   = "+48501234567"
  sender_name    = "YourCompany"
  sms_type       = "1"
  allow_long_sms = false
}

# Requires Terraform or OpenTofu 1.11 or later: password_wo is never stored in
# plan or state. Change password_wo_version whenever the secret changes.
resource "uptimekuma_notification_promosms" "write_only" {
  name = "PromoSMS with a write-only secret"

  login        = "your_promosms_login"
  phone_number = "+48501234567"

  password_wo         = "your-promosms-password"
  password_wo_version = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `login` (String, Sensitive) PromoSMS login/username for authentication
- `name` (String) Notification name
- `phone_number` (String) Recipient phone number for SMS messages

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `allow_long_sms` (Boolean) Allow long SMS messages (up to 639 characters instead of 159)
- `apply_existing` (Boolean)
- `is_active` (Boolean)
- `is_default` (Boolean)
- `password` (String, Sensitive) PromoSMS password for authentication. Stored in state; use `password_wo` to keep it out of state.
- `password_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) PromoSMS password for authentication, write-only: sent to Uptime Kuma on create and update but never stored in plan or state. Requires Terraform 1.11 or OpenTofu 1.11 or later. Conflicts with `password`; requires `password_wo_version`. An imported resource has no `password_wo_version` yet, so `terraform import` may store the server's value in `password` until the next apply with `password_wo` set removes it from state.
- `password_wo_version` (String) Any value that changes whenever `password_wo` changes, for example a counter or a hash of the secret's encrypted source. A change triggers an update that sends the current `password_wo`.
- `sender_name` (String) Sender name/ID displayed in the SMS
- `sms_type` (String) SMS type identifier

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Notification identifier
